title: RecipientIdentifier Display: O(n) allocation per hex byte
description: key.rs RecipientIdentifier::fmt: serial and SKI bytes are hex-encoded by mapping each byte to format!("{b:02x}"), collecting into Vec<String>, then .join(":"). This allocates one String per byte. A write!(f, "{:02x}", b) loop or hex encoding into a pre-sized buffer would avoid the allocation vector entirely. Not a hot path, but Display on credential types is often called in error/log paths under load.
